services.name: Log Cabin
services.desc: This fully-serviced cozy cabin is hand made with real logs. It features a gas fireplace, kitchenette with a bar-size fridge, electric range, microwave, coffee maker, and toaster. All dishes, cutlery, pots and pans are provided. There is a small table with four chairs and a TV/DVD with Satellite service. Towels are provided in the small bathroom with a toilet and shower. A Queen-size bed with linens is in this one-room cabin along with a single folding cot. Outside, the attached deck has two levels and provides a bench on the upper covered deck and a table with chairs and bench-railing on the larger lower level.
